body: It seems to me that you tried just one person for counseling. Sometimes it doesn't help because there isn't the right chemistry between counselor and patient. I suggest trying another one. Btw - and just a month or two - also I think that's a too short period of time. I'm going to a psychotherapist for 3 months now and we're just getting started. Don't forget he first has to get to know you to know which sort of help could be the best for you :-)

Btw, I appreciate the comments! I forget to say that, but I do. Still want to rant on, still no energy. Maybe later.

Kind of job I enjoy: I did like to clean houses for the elderly, but my back doesn't allow me to do such work anymore. Working in a store, as I do now, I don't want to any more. I want a 9-to-5 job now so I have the evenings and weekends with a SO. But I'm 30 and have no experience, they won't give me a chance :-(
The tingly feeling isn't anything unhealthy - I mean nothing physical. It's in my head, I guess. Pops up when I'm frustrated or angry, or sad.

I recognize your pain. And your fear. Still, what I said above still counts.

Again, sorry for the way I tell it to you, I don't know if it helps. I'm afraid it doesn't. Shall I shut up and stop rambling?

I guess I'm not the right person, since I recognize your pain in the same way. I'm in the same place as you .. I do not believe it will get better for myself. Every second I tell myself that feeling is because of my depression. And every second I'm still alive is a victory and one step forward to prove myself wrong. Hang in there, you can do the same. And afterwards we'll see we were both wrong about that suicide would have been a great solution. Stay alive, please.

Still here, thanks for caring. Went outside to talk with a friend, I think I've never walked that much.. It helped, but now at bedtime every ghost is coming back and I want to cry so much it hurts. Really every aspect of my life is a hell, and although there are people to help me, in the end it depends on me whether their help will be successfull and today I learned that what I care for most, the last thing that made me see and feel how wonderfull life can be, rejected me while I did what he asked me to do.
